title: Reference furniture may not physically fit: check corners geometrically
summary: The café reference's booth can't physically fit between table and parapet; the checker doesn't test furniture against walls. A corner-in-volume check caught it; the room was widened .4 m.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: for each furniture box corner: assert it lies inside the room's interior bounds (and outside other solids)

doc.when: Tight interiors matched to an AI reference.
doc.avoid: Shrinking people to fit; matching the impossible layout.
gotchas: Prefer widening the room slightly over intersecting geometry.

problem.symptom: Furniture pokes through walls or parapets while the checker is clean.
problem.cause: The reference layout is physically impossible; the checker tests bodies and floating props, not furniture-vs-wall.
problem.fix: Explicit corner checks; adjust the room (+.4 m) so nothing intersects.
problem.detect: A geometric corner/volume check per furniture group.
